$comment: A LOCKFILE FOR CLEARED CLAIMS (brief 02, next-need 1). The register records what is true NOW; it kept no record of what it said before, so a figure could change and neither a reader nor a review would see it — and the claims gate only ever checked current state. It has happened: commit 4c6f758 changed a cleared value from a candidate count to the FV-proven number. That was a correct change, and it was also invisible. Now any change to a cleared value or its evidence must update this file in the SAME commit, which puts the before and after in the diff where review can see them. Regenerate with: npm run claims-lock -- --update
